fhg.config.title: Faster Happy Ghast
fhg.config.enabled.tooltip: Turn off to fly a completely vanilla Happy Ghast.
fhg.config.speed.tooltip:
Top flying speed, relative to vanilla.
Vanilla (100%) is about 3.3 blocks/sec, slower than walking.
200% is about 6.6 blocks/sec, 300% is about 10.
fhg.config.vertical.tooltip:
Extra multiplier on climbing and diving, on top of top speed.
Hold jump to climb, look down and move forward to dive.
fhg.config.sprint_enabled.tooltip: Lets you sprint while riding. Hold the sprint key with forward held.
fhg.config.sprint_boost.tooltip:
Top speed multiplier while sprinting.
100% means sprinting gives no extra speed.
150% means sprinting is half again as fast as cruising.
fhg.config.responsiveness.tooltip:
How quickly the ghast reaches and sheds its top speed.
0% is vanilla's floaty drift, 100% stops on a dime.
Does not change top speed.
fhg.config.turn_speed.tooltip:
How fast the ghast swings towards where you are looking.
Vanilla is 8%. Higher turns tighter.
